e.title: SPLICE
e.summary: 合成已付/已发生损失模拟器（CRAN 1.1.2）：SPLICE 个体索赔模拟扩展
e.summary_en: Synthetic paid/incurred loss simulator (CRAN 1.1.2): SPLICE individual claim simulator extension
e.summary_hk: 合成已付/已發生損失模擬器（CRAN 1.1.2）：SPLICE 個體索賠模擬擴展
e.body:
SPLICE（CRAN 1.1.2）是 SynthETIC（[[synthetic]]）的扩展：模拟已付与已发生（paid and incurred）损失经验——比 SynthETIC 更完整的损失进展模拟（已付/已发生两条路径）。对 RIAA：准备金数据的合成生成——[[synthetic]]（SynthETIC）生成索赔事件、SPLICE 补充已付/已发生进展；合成三角形用于测试准备金方法（[[chainladder]]、[[reservingmodels]]）；个体索赔模拟（CAS 官方 imaginator 同范式）；适合准备金研究的方法验证。

## 同类工具
[[survpen]]、[[tidyextreme]]、[[tree-like-pin]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
SPLICE (CRAN 1.1.2) is an extension of SynthETIC ([[synthetic]]): simulating paid and incurred loss experience — more complete loss development simulation (both paid and incurred paths) than SynthETIC. For RIAA: synthetic generation of reserving data — [[synthetic]] (SynthETIC) generates claim events, SPLICE adds paid/incurred development; synthetic triangles for testing reserving methods ([[chainladder]], [[reservingmodels]]); the individual-claim simulation paradigm (same as CAS official imaginator); suits method validation in reserving research.

## Similar tools
[[survpen]]、[[tidyextreme]]、[[tree-like-pin]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
SPLICE（CRAN 1.1.2）是 SynthETIC（[[synthetic]]）的擴展：模擬已付與已發生（paid and incurred）損失經驗——比 SynthETIC 更完整的損失進展模擬（已付/已發生兩條路徑）。對 RIAA：準備金數據的合成生成——[[synthetic]]（SynthETIC）生成索賠事件、SPLICE 補充已付/已發生進展；合成三角形用於測試準備金方法（[[chainladder]]、[[reservingmodels]]）；個體索賠模擬（CAS 官方 imaginator 同範式）；適合準備金研究的方法驗證。

## 同類工具
[[survpen]]、[[tidyextreme]]、[[tree-like-pin]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
